system.description:
Automation: Rules reference · play automation in progress

You reach before you think, fingers closing as the ground drops away beneath your friend.

Rules

Action
Reaction
Attribute
Brawn
Target / range / shape
One adjacent willing creature beginning to fall
Duration
Resolve once at the stated trigger; applied conditions follow normal decay.
Equipment / acquisition
None.
Limits
Repeatable; pay the action and any stated costs each use.
Type
Skill / Utility

Reaction; requires a free hand and secure footing at the start. Weak and Standard leave the friend held at the edge until moved or released. If no support could bear both, DA states that before use; no impossible attempt.

Weak
Stop its fall; you drop prone at the edge.
Standard
Stop its fall and keep your footing.
Strong
Stop its fall and pull it into an adjacent free safe square.

Stability exception: this willing rescue movement ignores Stability. It does not allow moving an unwilling target or bypassing a grapple.
